## 简体中文
更新内容将会在 https://github.com/FFANXXY/Minepy-Grammar/blob/main/Lastest%20Grammar/zh_cn.md发布
主要更新内容
1. 变量运算
    - 实现`+` `-` `*` `/` `||` `&&` `>` `>=` `<` `<=`的运算
    - 允许实现 变量赋值，通过单层计算赋值
2. 逻辑语句
    - 实现`if(条件)`和`while(条件)`，语法与 `python` 类似
    
## English
Update content will be released at https://github.com/FFANXXY/Minepy-Grammar/blob/main/Lastest%20Grammar/en_us.md

Main Updates
1. Variable Operations
    - Implementation of operations for `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `||`, `&&`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`
    - Enables variable assignment through single-level computation assignments
2. Control Flow Statements
    - Implementation of `if(condition)` and `while(condition)`, with syntax similar to `Python`
